# @bot-wa/core (bot-wa-baileys monorepo)

> Transport-agnostic bot framework. The core (@bot-wa/core) runs any
> IProvider: @bot-wa/baileys (WhatsApp Web via Baileys 7), @bot-wa/meta
> (official WhatsApp Cloud API), @bot-wa/telegram, @bot-wa/discord.
> Flows for beginners (flow().say().ask()) compile to an async conversation
> runtime (bot.conversation with c.ask/c.waitText/c.choose). Priority
> dispatcher: commands > active conversation > matchers (normalized-equals
> default) > catch-all; first consumer wins. Constructing a Bot REQUIRES a
> provider: new Bot({ provider: new BaileysProvider({ session }) }).
> ESM-only, Node >= 20.

## Docs
- README: https://github.com/andresayac/bot-wa-baileys#readme
- Migration v1→v2: https://github.com/andresayac/bot-wa-baileys/blob/main/docs/MIGRATION-v1-to-v2.md

## Packages
- @bot-wa/core — Bot engine, IProvider v2, flows/conversations, hooks, plugins, scheduler, DI, testing kit (createTestBot/MockProvider from '@bot-wa/core/testing')
- @bot-wa/baileys — BaileysProvider (WhatsApp unofficial, QR/pairing code), RateLimiter, JID helpers
- @bot-wa/meta — CloudAPIProvider (WhatsApp Cloud API official, webhook; feed inbound via provider.ingest(body, headers))
- @bot-wa/telegram — TelegramProvider · @bot-wa/discord — DiscordProvider
- @bot-wa/sqlite-store — SQLiteStore (better-sqlite3, WAL) · @bot-wa/redis-store — RedisStore
- @bot-wa/ai — aiPlugin + AIClient

## API essentials
- import { Bot } from '@bot-wa/core'; import { BaileysProvider } from '@bot-wa/baileys'
- new Bot({ provider: new BaileysProvider({ session, qr: { terminal: true } }) }) ; await bot.start()
- bot.when(trigger, handler) — trigger: 'texto' (equals normalizado) | RegExp | { pattern, match: 'contains'|'startsWith' } | fn
- bot.command('reset', handler) — always beats active conversations
- bot.use(flow('kw').say(t).ask(t, key, { validate, retries, timeout }).choose(p, {...}).do(fn))
- bot.conversation(name, async (c, ctx) => { await c.ask(q); await c.waitText(); await c.choose(p, labels) })
- ctx fields: ctx.from (chat id), ctx.sender, ctx.body, ctx.ref (MessageRef { id, chatId, native? }; was ctx.key), ctx.raw (native payload; was ctx.rawMessage), ctx.senderInfo, ctx.chat, ctx.media, ctx.tools
- Outbound content is a tagged union: bot.send(chatId, { kind: 'image', media: { url }, caption }) ; bot.sendText(chatId, text) ; bot.broadcast(chatIds, { kind: 'text', text })
- before('send') hook payload: { chatId, content, options } (was { jid, content, options })
- Testing without WhatsApp: import { createTestBot } from '@bot-wa/core/testing'

## Other exports worth knowing
- Hooks/plugins: bot.before/after/onError(event, handler), bot.plug(plugin, config) (returns unplug()), bot.provide(name, value)
- Scheduler: bot.schedule(cron, fn), bot.every(interval, fn), bot.delay(duration, fn)
- Media handlers: bot.onImage/onAudio/onVideo/onDocument/onSticker/onLocation/onContact/onPoll(handler)
- Provider events forwarded on the bot: bot.on('ready'|'qr'|'connection'|'reaction'|'poll'|'call'|'group'|'presence'|'status', ...)
- ctx (MessageContext) helpers: ctx.reply/say/answer/text, ctx.photo/video/audio/voice/file/sticker/location/contact/poll/buttons, ctx.react/quote/markRead/typing/recording/delete, ctx.pass()/abort(), ctx.sendNative(provider, payload)
- Stores: store: new SQLiteStore({ file }) from @bot-wa/sqlite-store, new RedisStore({ url }) from @bot-wa/redis-store, or storeConfig { file } for the built-in MemoryStore; implement IStore for custom backends
- v1 sub-APIs (bot.groups/profile/privacy/chats/presence) were REMOVED — reach the Baileys socket via provider.socket for WhatsApp-specific ops

## @bot-wa/ai (separate package)
- Install: pnpm add @bot-wa/ai + the chosen provider's SDK (@anthropic-ai/sdk, openai, or @google/genai; ollama needs none, it talks plain HTTP via fetch)
- bot.plug(aiPlugin({ provider, model, apiKey, baseUrl, persona, maxTokens, effort, context: { maxMessages }, autoReply, resetCommand, errorMessage, refusalMessage, humanizeTyping })) — catch-all text autoresponder with per-chat history + a /reset command (install after slashCommandsPlugin so its /reset wins)
- Providers: 'anthropic' (default model claude-opus-4-8), 'openai', 'ollama' (both require `model` explicitly), 'gemini' (default gemini-2.0-flash), and OpenAI-compatible presets 'deepseek'|'qwen'|'glm'|'kimi'|'groq'|'openrouter'|'mistral'|'grok'|'together' (each with its conventional env var, e.g. DEEPSEEK_API_KEY, and a default model)
- ctx.tools.ai (AIClient, via bot.provide('ai', client)): ask(prompt), generate(input), stream(input)
- Testing: MockAIProvider (implements AIProvider, no network) + ContextManager/AIClient exported for unit tests
